items.title: Members of Parliament
items.description: Briefed Members of Parliament from multiple countries on the human rights situation facing Eelam Tamils, and urged them to raise it in their own parliaments.

items.title: UN Human Rights Council, Geneva
items.description: Engaged the OHCHR, its Sri Lanka Accountability Project (OSLAP) and diplomatic missions in Geneva ahead of Human Rights Council sessions, pressing for international accountability.

items.title: European Union
items.description: Pressed EU officials at the EEAS and European Commission, and Members of the European Parliament, to withdraw Sri Lanka's GSP+ trade privileges and support an international inquiry into the genocide.

items.title: Government Officials
items.description: Kept foreign ministries and government officials informed on the situation of Eelam Tamils, with concrete recommendations for how their governments can act.

items.title: Briefings
items.description: Delivered research and briefing papers on land grabs, militarization and accountability, so policymakers act on evidence rather than on Colombo's version of events.
